description: Main window capability. Minimal by design. The webview previously held fs:default + fs:scope-home, i.e. read AND write across the whole home directory, which included ~/.kube/config, ~/.aws/credentials and ~/.ssh. The frontend only needs to read one image (cluster avatar) and write one text file (saved pod logs), both after a native file dialog, so filesystem scope is narrowed to the standard user directories. No dotfile in $HOME is reachable. See .claude/tauri.md for the follow-up plan (move both operations into Rust commands and drop the fs grants entirely) and for the known limitation that picking a file outside these directories now fails, because the dialog plugin does not extend fs scope at runtime in Tauri v2.
